title: FoodDash
summary: Cross-platform food delivery app with real-time tracking, AI-powered recommendations, and seamless checkout.
description: Built a comprehensive food delivery platform from the ground up. The app features real-time order tracking with live map updates, an AI-driven recommendation engine that learns user preferences, and a frictionless checkout flow supporting multiple payment methods. The backend uses microservices architecture for scalability.
features: Real-time order tracking with live map

title: TaskFlow
summary: Collaborative project management tool with Kanban boards, Gantt charts, and team analytics dashboard.
description: A full-featured project management application designed for remote teams. TaskFlow supports Kanban boards, timeline views, sprint planning, and comprehensive analytics. Built with real-time collaboration using WebSockets, enabling multiple team members to work on the same board simultaneously.

title: FitTracker
summary: Health and fitness app with workout tracking, nutrition logging, and AI-powered personal coaching.
description: An all-in-one fitness companion that combines workout tracking, nutrition logging, and AI-powered personal coaching. The app uses machine learning to adapt workout plans based on user progress and recovery data. Integrates with Apple Health and Google Fit for comprehensive health monitoring.

title: CloudDeploy
summary: DevOps dashboard for managing cloud infrastructure, deployments, and monitoring across multiple providers.
description: A unified DevOps dashboard that simplifies cloud infrastructure management across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Features one-click deployments, real-time monitoring with custom alerting, cost tracking and optimization recommendations, and a CI/CD pipeline visualizer.

title: ChatConnect
summary: Real-time messaging platform with end-to-end encryption, file sharing, video calls, and team collaboration workspaces.
description: A secure messaging platform built for teams and enterprises. ChatConnect features end-to-end encrypted private messaging, group channels with threaded conversations, high-quality video conferencing, and seamless file sharing with version history. The platform handles 10M+ daily messages with sub-100ms delivery latency.
features: File sharing with preview and versioning

title: ShopSmart
summary: AI-powered e-commerce platform with visual search, personalized recommendations, and one-click checkout.
description: A next-generation e-commerce platform that leverages computer vision and machine learning to transform the shopping experience. Features include visual search (upload a photo to find matching products), personalized recommendation engine, virtual try-on for clothing, and a one-click checkout flow that reduced cart abandonment by 35%.
